_comment: Thresholds set from measurement, not from aspiration -- and be clear about
which machine each number came from.
Four runs against one unchanged build on the DEV VPS, which is loaded,
scored performance 99, 99, 95, 97 (total blocking time 80-170ms), while
accessibility, best-practices and SEO returned 100 every time. The first
run on the CI RUNNER, which is what actually enforces this file, scored
100 across all four with 0ms blocking time.
So runner variance is not yet characterised -- one sample is not a range.
The floors stay where they are until it is. The performance floor is
deliberately loose: it catches a catastrophe (a render-blocking script, an
unoptimised hero image) and is NOT a target. Passing it is not evidence of
anything.
ROUTES. Scoring only '/' was close to scoring nothing: logged out it is a
200-element shell, and 38 of the 63 accessibility audits came back 'not
applicable' because there was nothing on the page to judge. Adding four
routes immediately found real problems that the empty dashboard hid --
unlabelled month-navigation buttons on /calendar, contrast failures on
/about and /settings, links distinguished only by colour on /about.
Per-route accessibility floors sit just under what each route scores
today, so CI locks in "no worse" while any remaining debt stays visible in
the job summary rather than being averaged away. Raise them as the debt is
paid -- four of the five routes moved from 0.92/0.95 to 0.98 once the
contrast tokens were split in #17.
These are all logged-out views. The deck and feed with real content are
still unmeasured here; that needs an authenticated run.
Read the reported numbers in the job summary for the real signal.

routes.note: was 0.92 for contrast on link rows and colour-only links; both fixed in #17, now 100

95 not 98: two buttons put near-white text on the Bluesky (3.46:1) and Mastodon (4.18:1) brand colours. Fixing needs the same text/background token split as --color-primary, across 63 sites, and darkening the tokens outright would drop their 17 text uses to 3.31 and 2.90 — a decision about platform identity colour. best-practices is lower because /api/push/* are Vercel functions that 404 under a static preview, tripping errors-in-console
was 0.95 for unlabelled month arrows and a contrast miss; both fixed, now 100

_mustPassNote: errors-in-console is not here: a static preview has no /api routes, so push endpoints 404 and every page would fail it. color-contrast is not here either -- it is real debt, held by the per-route floors above rather than blocking the build today.
